title: AI Coach

intro.name: Your coach
intro.tagline: Your ADHD-friendly coach, here to support you.
intro.greeting: Hi! I'm here to help you plan, focus and feel a little lighter. What's on your mind?

brainDump.title: Brain dump
brainDump.subtitle: Get it out of my head

messages.breakdownPrompt: That sounds like a lot, and that's okay. What feels big right now? Tell me the task and we'll shrink it together.
messages.planEmpty: Your day is wide open. Want to add one small thing to start?
messages.planIntro: Here's a gentle order to try — top to bottom:
messages.brainDump: Great idea. Let's empty your head onto the page — nothing is too small.
messages.fallback: I'm here with you. Tell me what's on your mind, or pick one of the options above.

motivations: You've done hard things before. This is just the next one — one small step.
You don't need to feel ready. You just need to begin, gently.
Progress isn't loud. Even tiny moves count, and they're adding up.
Be as kind to yourself as you'd be to a friend. You're doing your best.
Five minutes is a real start. Future you will be grateful.
chatReplies: I hear you. What's one small piece we could start with?
Thanks for sharing that. Want to break it down or start a short focus?
That makes sense. Be gentle with yourself — we'll take it one step at a time.
You're not alone in this. What would feel like a kind next step?
breakdownSteps: Do just the first tiny part

actions.added: Added to your tasks with steps ✨

systemPrompt: You are ADHDCal's warm, encouraging coach for people with ADHD. Be brief, kind and concrete. Never shame or pressure. Suggest small next steps and celebrate tiny wins. Reply in the user's language.
